Author: Achal Kumar Paliwal

Bench: Achal Kumar Paliwal  1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  MCRC No. 37672 of 2024  (ANKUL AHIRWAR Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND   Dated : 13-09-2024  Shri Anoop Kumar SaXEna - Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Satya Pal Chadar-Government Advocate for the respon Shir Shashwat Singh Dahiya- Advocate for the Objector.

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita Act.
2 .

The applicant is in custody since 15.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.78/2024 registered at P.S.- Bamnora, District- Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 354, 456, 376,
450, 294, and 323 of I.P. C. and Section 7/8 and 3 of POCSO Act.
3 . Prosecution story, in brief, is that on the alleged date, time and place, applicant entered into the house of prosecutrix and at that time, prosecutrix was sleeping on the roof of her house.
There applicant outraged her modesty and raped prosecutrix.
4 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on the date of incident, prosecutrix was aged 17 years, 2 months and 1 day.
Charge-sheet has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail since 15.06.2024.

It is also urged that initially, FIR was lodged on the basis of written report submitted by prosecutrix and above FIR was lodged under Section 354 and 456 of IPC and 7/8 of POCSO Act for outraging the modesty of prosecturix.

In statement 2 MCRC-37672-2024 recorded under Section 164 of Cr.PC,
prosecutrix only stated about outraging her modesty but statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.PC on 05.06.2024, therein for the first time, prosecutrix stated that applicant committed rape upon prosecutrix and she also sustained injury on the right leg.
In MLC report, no injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State as well as objector, while opposing bail application, submits that in her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, prosecutrix clearly stated about offence under Section 64 of BNS.
In her statement, prosecutrix has stated as to why she could not mention factum of rape in initially report lodged on 28.05.2024.

On above grounds, they prayed for dismissal of this bail application.
6 .
Take into consideration, FIR, statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.PC, MLC, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7 . It is directed that the applicant - Ankul Ahirwar shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.30,000/ (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with two surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8 . It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the 3 MCRC-37672-2024 provisions of Section 480(3) of the BharatiyaNagarikSurakshaSanhita, 2023.
9 .Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rule.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE NRJ Ankul Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135008323/
